title: 道富环球：亚洲科技估值偏低，韩国配置价值凸显
speaker: Ben Lux

segments.en: Korea is interesting for us definitely we have seen I would say more of a wipe out since the sort of the summer right with the leveraging cycle that we've seen there.
segments.zh: 韩国对我们来说很有趣，自夏季以来，由于杠杆周期，市场出现了较大幅度的出清。

segments.en: And I think a lot of what was sold off was really not driven by corporate fundamentals. It was a lot more driven by how much of that was leverage base.
segments.zh: 我认为许多抛售并非由基本面驱动，而是由杠杆头寸驱动。

segments.en: And and how much was that was obviously driven by that hype overall that we're seeing in the ex-us tech story right.
segments.zh: 很大程度上也受到美国以外科技股炒作情绪的影响。

segments.en: But as people go back into the Asia story I think Asia remains to be this undervalued and under owned area that investors may not think about it too much right now.
segments.zh: 但随着资金回流亚洲，我们认为亚洲仍是估值偏低且配置不足的市场，投资者目前可能关注不多。

segments.en: Because of the fact that us has done so well. But outside of that we think where the earnings are where the potential is.
segments.zh: 因为美国市场表现太好，但除此之外，我们认为盈利和潜力所在之处。

segments.en: Asia tech remains to be that core strategy for us. Yeah our institutions going back into Korea because you guys have a unique window and to flows.
segments.zh: 亚洲科技仍是我们核心策略。机构资金正回流韩国，因为你们对资金流有独特的观察窗口。

segments.en: Yes, so the flows that we're seeing is that Korea is now a modest overweight in terms of what we see since the sort of the year.
segments.zh: 是的，我们观察到的资金流显示，韩国目前是适度超配，这是年初以来的情况。
